column1: # Nightly t2 bench baselines (ADR 0080), recorded on GitHub ubuntu-24.04 runners (4 vCPUs, 4 sim workers).
# Per scenario and runner CPU model: the runs recorded, the median tick p50 and p99 (ms), the median calibration-normalized
# p50, and the tolerances (factors) check-bench.sh allows: 1.10 / 1.30 from three runs on; provisional rows (fewer runs)
# 1.25 / 1.50; the AMD EPYC 9V45, whose nightly medians spread up to 11%, 1.20 / 1.50 (b4 1.30 / 1.60).
# Recorded from 24 probe nightlies of the s2/gameplay/b4/stress steps on main 729f335 plus this PR (2026-10-18).
# To add or re-record rows see ADR 0080 ("Adding or re-recording a baseline row").
# B3 has no row: its p50 is dominated by idle ticks (30% spread on one CPU model); B3 is gated by its planning check.
